structure: Per-head fusion of gqa_full = per-head bmm_softmax (scores + row-softmax over the key axis) + a context matmul. identity[128,128] loaded once into SBUF (moving operand for every is_transpose=True matmul). Outer loop kh in affine_range(8): build per-head shared operands reused across the 2 query groups (qh=2*kh+grp) and all 32 t_q: k_t[d=128(par), n_k=4096(free)] from 32 k subtiles -- load v2[0,a,b,:,kh,:]=[c=n_k_sub(par)=128, d(free)=128], identity-transpose -> PSUM [d, n_k_sub], copy to SBUF at column offset 128*(4*a+b) (a in 8, b in 4); v_sb[p=n_v_sub(par)=128, n_v=4096(free)] with NO transpose -- load v3[0,t_v,:,kh*128:+128]=[p, d] directly (already the moving layout) at column offset 128*t_v (t_v in 32). Inner loops grp in affine_range(2), t_q in affine_range(32): SCORES S[m_q,n_k]=sum_d q_h[m_q,d]*k_h[n_k,d] (contract d): load q v1[t_q,:,qh,:]=[p=m_q(par)=128, d(free)=128], identity-transpose -> q_t[d(par)=128, m_q(free)=128]; 8 n-chunks of 512: SINGLE-PASS D=128 main matmul nc_matmul(stationary=q_t[128,128], moving=k_t[128,512]) -> [m_q(par)=128, n_k=512(free)] PSUM, copy into resident score[128,4096] SBUF. SOFTMAX over the 4096-wide key free axis entirely in SBUF, fp32, reference op order: score[128,4096]=tensor_scalar(score, *scale) with scale=1/sqrt(128)=0.08838835; neg_max[128,1]=tensor_reduce(nl.max, score, axis=[1], negate=True) (writes -row_max directly); exp_t[128,4096]=activation(op=nl.exp, data=score, bias=neg_max[128,1], scale=1.0); row_sum[128,1]=tensor_reduce(nl.add, exp_t, axis=[1]) (EXPLICIT Vector add, not fused into activation reduce_res); recip[128,1]=reciprocal(row_sum); attn[128,4096]=tensor_scalar(exp_t, *recip[128,1]). CONTEXT O[m_q,d]=sum_{n_k} A[m_q,n_k]*v_h[n_k,d] (contract n_k): o_psum=nl.zeros([128,128]) per (kh,grp,t_q); for j=4*a+b in 32: identity-transpose attn[:,128*j:+128] -> A_t[n_k_sub=128(par), m_q=128(free)] copy to SBUF, o_psum += nc_matmul(stationary=A_t[128,128], moving=v_sb[:,128*j:+128]) -> [m_q(par)=128, d(free)=128]; after all 32 j, copy o_psum to SBUF and store out[0,kh,grp,t_q,:,:]. j=4*a+b flattening makes the key column offset 128*(4*a+b) and the value subtile t_v=j index the same absolute sequence position n. fp32 throughout; NO softmax op reads/writes a PSUM tile (PSUM banks hold only matmul/transpose results, copied to SBUF immediately); the full [128,4096] score/attn live in SBUF, not PSUM.
arg_roles: v1=q (32,128,16,128)=[t_q, p, qh, d], n_q=128*t_q+p; v2=k (1,8,4,128,8,128)=[0,a,b,c,kh,d], n_k=128*(4*a+b)+c; v3=v (1,32,128,1024)=[0,t_v,p,kh*128+d], n_v=128*t_v+p; out=v4 (1,8,2,32,128,128)=[0,kh,grp,t_q,pos,d] -> ref[0, qh=2*kh+grp, n=128*t_q+pos, d]. transform_to_nki_inputs is reshape-only; transform_nki_outputs reshapes v4 to the reference (1,16,4096,128). Reference forward: per qh, S=q_h@k_h.T/sqrt(D), A=softmax_over_Nk(S), O=A@v_h; kv head kh=qh//2 (xk=np.repeat(k, n_rep=2, axis=head)).

structure: IDENTICAL math to gqa_full_v1; the ONLY change is the context-loop schedule. v1 interleaves per key subtile j a serial transpose(PE)->copy(Vec/Scl)->matmul(PE) chain 32x. A_t transpose is exact identity-matmul so packing-then-matmul == transpose-then-matmul (bit-identical); accumulation order unchanged. Everything else (score build, full-width fp32 softmax epilogue, k_t/v_sb residency, output stores) is verbatim v1.

structure: Query-tile batching under the D2c base (two-phase + scale-fold + defer-normalize). WITHIN each (kh,grp): block the 32 query tiles into groups of M_SUB. Phase 1 (per block): for each of M_SUB tiles build score[128,4096] (8 matmuls), softmax (scale-folded, max on unscaled score, scaled [128,1] bias, explicit tensor_reduce add row-sum, reciprocal kept in recip[128,M_SUB]), transpose all 32 exp subtiles into a_t_bank[128, M_SUB*N] at slot mm*N+128*j. Phase 2 (per block): for each mm, o_psum=zeros; accumulate a_t_bank[mm slot,j].T @ v_sb[j] over j=0..31; o_sb=tensor_scalar(o_psum,*recip[mm]) (128-wide deferred normalize); store. Pure reschedule of v3c; per-tile arithmetic + j order unchanged. Never blocks across kv heads/query groups.
